digest.component_or_area: review-bot shutdown drain and retryable failure handling
propositions: The review-bot container shutdown drain (45s) times out before in-flight reviews complete (measured 260-911s), causing cancellation that posts a fail-closed LLM-Review -1 vote which blocks the backfill reconciler recovery path
GitHub git-fetch transient hangs (>300s) trigger the 300s _GIT_TIMEOUT, which adapter.py converts to a vote-bearing BLOCK that reconcile.py treats as already-voted and skips forever
Change 1: increase DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS from 45 to 1200 and stop_grace_period to 1320s to allow in-flight reviews to complete before container shutdown

Change 2: for retryable gap reasons (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled), post no vote and record the attempt in review_attempts table so the backfill reconciler can retry, instead of posting a fail-closed -1
After N consecutive retryable failures (default 3) on the same (change_id, revision), escalate by posting fail-closed -1 with retries-exhausted note and emitting VOTER_ERROR metric
Terminal outcomes (finding, indeterminate, gate-disabled) continue to cast fail-closed -1 votes; vote-less changes remain unsubmittable and eligible for backfill reconciler re-drive
